caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a handle on its right side. The jug has a slightly flared rim and a rounded, cylindrical body that narrows near the middle. The body of the jug is rendered in shades of brown with darker brown decorative patterns and stripes present near the upper and lower parts, as well as on the central surface of the jug. The handle, rim, and decorative designs are all in a darker brown color compared to the lighter brown base of the jug. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The jug is centered in the composition, taking up most of the image space, and is drawn with realistic shading to indicate its three-dimensional form.
title: Water Pitcher
